subject: note: Stoics like Seneca took a more radical view of suicide, arguing that the brevity of human life was no source of woe. When a human life no longer flourishes because of bad fortune, one is permitted to end it.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
